game: Halo: The Master Chief Collection (AlphaRing split-screen)

requires.hint: install the AlphaRing mod: put its WTSAPI32.dll in MCC/Binaries/Win64, next to MCC-Win64-Shipping.exe. In the game, press F4, add the players, give each one a controller, click Enable, then press F4 again to close it. Anti-cheat is off while it runs, so play the campaign or custom games, not online matchmaking.
